task.description: TEST-RUNNER's rework1 full-suite gate found a genuine regression this branch caused: this run added `role_claims_synced_at` to `Letflow.Identity.User` (§2.2's new field), and `lib/letflow/identity_migration.ex`'s `copy_users/2` (~line 155) has no `select:` restriction, so it now pulls that new field into a query against the LEGACY, frozen `public.users` table (which was never migrated to carry that column), causing `Postgrex.Error ... undefined_column` -- 7 test failures in test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs. Fix: add the same kind of explicit `select:` restriction `copy_groups/2` (same module) already carries from an earlier REQ-074 column-addition hazard of this identical class -- read copy_groups/2's existing guard first and mirror its exact shape/pattern for copy_users/2, restricting the query to only the legacy columns that actually exist in public.users. Run `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` and `mix test test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs` and quote real output confirming all pass. Also re-run the previously-regressed/REQ-378 test files (test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_test.exs test/letflow/plugs/api_pipeline_integration_test.exs test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs test/letflow/plugs/iss0736_oidc_live_revocation_test.exs) to confirm no new regression. Run everything in the foreground -- no background Monitor waiting.
acceptance_criteria: copy_users/2 fixed to mirror copy_groups/2's existing select-restriction pattern for this exact hazard class
test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs passes in full, real output quoted

result.summary: Fixed lib/letflow/identity_migration.ex's copy_users/2 (~line 153): added an explicit `select: struct(u, [:id, :username, :display_name, :email, :password_hash, :status, :auth_source, :external_id, :external_realm, :inserted_at, :updated_at])` restriction, mirroring copy_groups/2's existing guard pattern for this exact hazard class, plus a comment block explaining why (REQ-378's `role_claims_synced_at` column exists only on the new per-tenant `users` table via priv/repo/migrations/20260921000001_add_role_claims_synced_at_to_users.exs, not on the legacy frozen public.users table copy_users/2 reads from). No other lines in the module were touched. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` -> clean, no warnings/errors ('Compiling 1 file (.ex)', exit clean). `mix test test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs` -> 'Finished in 11.1 seconds ... Result: 12 passed', 0 failures (previously 7 failures with Postgrex undefined_column on public.users.role_claims_synced_at). Re-ran the 4 REQ-378-related files (test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_test.exs test/letflow/plugs/api_pipeline_integration_test.exs test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs test/letflow/plugs/iss0736_oidc_live_revocation_test.exs) together -> 'Finished in 59.4 seconds ... Result: 49 passed', 0 failures -- no new regression. Judgment on gating: this delta is test-infra-adjacent (a `select:` column-list restriction in a one-time legacy-table copy utility, matching an already-approved pattern in the same module) and does not touch any tenant-data API/auth path itself -- SECURITY-REVIEWER/REVIEWER re-review is not required for this specific delta per the dispatch note, but ORCH should confirm that judgment before merge since this module does interact with identity data during cutover.
